user.title: wire-pod server
user.description: Address of the wire-pod server that the Vector is paired with. Only its robot list is read here; the camera is not opened.

robot.title: Robot
robot.description: Choose the robot. The camera is added even while the robot sleeps; it shows its status until frames arrive.

error.cannot_connect: wire-pod did not answer, or answered with something other than its robot list.
error.invalid_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://.

abort.already_configured: This robot is already set up.

init.title: Thumbnail refresh
init.description: Each thumbnail refresh opens the robot's camera briefly and, when it closes, wire-pod turns the camera stream off, which also interrupts any other camera user. 0 means thumbnails update only while someone watches live.
